p: Orchard Street is a short cut-through in the middle of Preston, putting this Admiral within easy reach of everything in town. As an adult gaming centre, it's 18+ only.

Preston Market is right next door, under its great Victorian iron canopy, with food stalls and traders that make a good stop in their own right. A few minutes' walk takes you to the Flag Market, overlooked by the grand Harris Museum building. Head south through town and you'll reach Avenham Park and Miller Park, two Victorian parks rolling down to the River Ribble, ideal for a walk or a picnic. On matchdays, Preston North End's Deepdale ground is a short trip north of the centre.
